recipe.visualDefinition: A high-key, black-and-white studio portrait of a woman seated on the floor in a cross-legged, compact pose. The lighting is soft and diffused, creating smooth gradients on the skin and a seamless transition into a pure white background.
coreVisualRelationships: Subject centered against a void-like white background
Interlocking limbs creating a triangular compositional base
Dark hair providing the primary tonal contrast against pale skin and background
Direct eye contact establishing a focal point at the top of the triangle
coreInvariants: Soft, non-directional shadow under the subject

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Centered vertically and horizontally, occupying approximately 70% of the vertical frame.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The subject's face and dark hair serve as the primary anchor.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Starts at the eyes, follows the vertical line of the raised knee down to the crossed feet, and circles back up through the arms.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Expansive white space surrounding the subject on all sides, emphasizing isolation and form.

colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Zero saturation; high value range with compressed mid-tones for a luminous skin effect.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a high-key black and white photograph of a woman with long dark hair seated on a white floor in a cross-legged pose. Use soft, diffused studio lighting to minimize harsh shadows. The background should be a seamless, infinite white.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: If adding text, use a minimalist serif or sans-serif font in black, placed in the negative space to maintain the clean composition.

verificationChecks: Is the background pure white without visible corners?
Are the skin tones smooth with soft shadow transitions?

mustRedesign: Visible background textures or room details
postGenerationChecks: Check for seamless background integration at the floor level.
Ensure the hair maintains detail despite being the darkest element.
Verify the triangular composition is stable and centered.
Confirm no color cast is present in the grayscale.
recipe.reuseFormula: Subject [Person] + Pose [Seated/Compact] + Lighting [High-key/Soft Studio] + Palette [Monochrome] + Background [Seamless White Cyclorama]
